ActionStartQuest.xml:
<Property>
                <Name>ActionStartQuest</Name>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Quest</DataType>
                  <Name>Quest</Name>
                  <NeededProperty>Quest</NeededProperty>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                  <Name>InheritQuestArea</Name>
                  <Description>Indicates whether the action should pass on the quest area of the the quest assigned to this action</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                  <Name>InheritQuestSession</Name>
                  <Description>Indicates whether the action should pass on the quest session of the the quest assigned to this action</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                  <Name>InheritQuestObjects</Name>
                  <Description>Inherits the list of all objects that were related to that quest, so they can be used by object actions</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                  <Name>UseCurrentSession</Name>
                  <Description>Indicates whether the quest should be spawned for the session where the current player is in</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Asset</DataType>
                  <Name>QuestSession</Name>
                  <Description>The session where this quest should be started or a region(= list of sessions) where a session is randomly chosen from if the player entered that session already</Description>
                  <NeededProperty>Session;Region</NeededProperty>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                  <Name>GetQuestSessionFromArea</Name>
                  <Description>If true the session is determined by the given area. Needs an area to be set and also InheritQuestArea needs to be set!</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
              </Property>

Condition.xml:
<Property>
            <Name>Condition</Name>
            <HasImplementation>1</HasImplementation>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Choice</DataType>
              <Name>SubConditionCompletionOrder</Name>
              <Description>Parallel: All sub conditions can be solved at any time. Linear: The sub conditions have to be completed in order. Mutually Exclusive: Only one sub condition has to be completed and the sub conditions are solvable before the main condition.</Description>

              <DataSet>SubConditionCompletionOrder</DataSet>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
              <Name>IsOptional</Name>
              <Description>Set to true, if it is not needed to satisfy this condition to satisfy the parent condition</Description>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
              <Name>LinkAllActionsToQuest</Name>
            </ValueDefinition>
          </Property>

ConditionDecisionOption.xml:
<Property>
                <Name>ConditionDecisionOption</Name>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Text</DataType>
                  <Name>DecisionOptionText</Name>
                  <Description>The text displayed on the decision button that describes the decision option</Description>
                  <NeededProperty>Text</NeededProperty>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Text</DataType>
                  <Name>DecisionOptionInfotip</Name>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>AutoCreateAsset</DataType>
                  <Name>ActionList</Name>
                  <Description>A list of actions that should be executed when the user chose this option</Description>
                  <AllowedTemplates>Actions</AllowedTemplates>
                  <AllowedProperties/>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Vector</DataType>
                  <Name>UnlockRequirements</Name>
                  <Description>A list of assets that need to be unlocked to be able to choose this decision option</Description>
                  <Items>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Asset</DataType>
                      <Name>RequiredUnlock</Name>
                      <NeededProperty>Locked</NeededProperty>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                  </Items>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Text</DataType>
                  <Name>UnlockInfotipDescription</Name>
                  <Description>Infotip text that is displayed when this option is locked</Description>
                  <NeededProperty>Text</NeededProperty>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                  <Name>HideDecisionPanelAfterChoice</Name>
                  <Description>Indicates whether the decision popup should close after this option was taken</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Vector</DataType>
                  <Name>FollowUpDecisionList</Name>
                  <Description>A list of follow up decisions that will be a result of this decision option</Description>
                  <Items>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>AutoCreateAsset</DataType>
                      <Name>FollowUpDecision</Name>
                      <AllowedTemplates>ConditionDecision</AllowedTemplates>
                      <AllowedProperties/>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                  </Items>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                  <Name>HasDecisionCostBehavior</Name>
                  <Description>If true, any ActionAddGoodsToItemContainer in the action list would be evaluated and following things happen: 1. Decision gets disabled if player could not pay the resources 2. Resource requirements will be shown in infotip</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                  <Name>HasNotification</Name>
                  <Description>If true, triggers the DecisionNotification when the decision option was chosen</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>AutoCreateAsset</DataType>
                  <Name>DecisionNotification</Name>
                  <Description>Will get triggered when this decision option was chosen and HasNotification is true</Description>
                  <AllowedTemplates>CharacterNotification</AllowedTemplates>
                  <AllowedProperties/>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                  <Name>ShowDecisionBuffs</Name>
                  <Description>If true, buff icons with infotip will be shown for each buff action in the action list</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
              </Property>

ConditionQuestEscort.xml:
<Property>
                <Name>ConditionQuestEscort</Name>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Vector</DataType>
                  <Name>EscortObjects</Name>
                  <Items>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>AutoCreateAsset</DataType>
                      <Name>EscortObject</Name>
                      <Description>Which objects the player has to escort. Each List entry contains an exact amount of objects to escort.</Description>
                      <AllowedTemplates>QuestObjectList</AllowedTemplates>
                      <AllowedProperties/>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                  </Items>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Vector</DataType>
                  <Name>EscortObjectsPrebuilt</Name>
                  <Items>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>AutoCreateAsset</DataType>
                      <Name>EscortObject</Name>
                      <AllowedTemplates>ConditionObjectPrebuiltObject;ObjectFilterWithSignsAndFeedback</AllowedTemplates>
                      <AllowedProperties/>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                  </Items>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Integer</DataType>
                  <Name>MinSurvivors</Name>
                  <Description>Defines the minimum amount of escorted ships that should survive, otherwise the Quest will fail.</Description>
                  <Min>1</Min>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>AutoCreateAsset</DataType>
                  <Name>SpawnArea</Name>
                  <AllowedTemplates>QuestSpawnArea</AllowedTemplates>
                  <AllowedProperties/>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Vector</DataType>
                  <Name>Destinations</Name>
                  <Items>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Choice</DataType>
                      <Name>MoveDirection</Name>
                      <Description>Defines the target where the escorted ships move to.</Description>
                      <DataSet>QuestEscortMoveTarget</DataSet>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Asset</DataType>
                      <Name>TargetObject</Name>
                      <Description>Defines the target object where the escorted objects should move to.</Description>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>AutoCreateAsset</DataType>
                      <Name>TargetSpawnArea</Name>
                      <AllowedTemplates>QuestSpawnArea</AllowedTemplates>
                      <AllowedProperties/>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                      <Name>TargetObjectDespawn</Name>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Float</DataType>
                      <Name>TargetObjectDamage</Name>
                      <Description>Initial damage of target ships in percent [0..1]</Description>
                      <Min>0</Min>
                      <Max>1</Max>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>AutoCreateAsset</DataType>
                      <Name>PrebuiltObject</Name>
                      <AllowedTemplates>ConditionObjectPrebuiltObject</AllowedTemplates>
                      <AllowedProperties/>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                  </Items>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Float</DataType>
                  <Name>EscortObjectDamage</Name>
                  <Description>Initial damage of escort ships in percent [0..1]</Description>
                  <Min>0</Min>
                  <Max>1</Max>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Integer</DataType>
                  <Name>EscortBeginRadius</Name>
                  <Description>The radius in what a player ship has to be to start the escort. In game, this is dynamic: 11 + colliderShipA + colliderShipB. It would be better if this was dynamically calculated, but we have not data about the colliders at the time of the check. So for now, a range of 32 should be sufficient for even the longest ships. Also note, that as of now, this value is never overwritten. </Description>
                  <Min>0</Min>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Choice</DataType>
                  <Name>EscortObjectDespawn</Name>
                  <Description>The way how the escort object should despawn after the quest ended</Description>
                  <DataSet>QuestObjectDespawn</DataSet>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Time</DataType>
                  <Name>EscortObjectDespawnDelay</Name>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Choice</DataType>
                  <Name>AttackerObjectDespawn</Name>
                  <Description>The way how the attacker object should despawn after the quest ended</Description>
                  <DataSet>QuestObjectDespawn</DataSet>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Time</DataType>
                  <Name>AttackerObjectDespawnDelay</Name>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Vector</DataType>
                  <Name>AttackerObjects</Name>
                  <Items>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>AutoCreateAsset</DataType>
                      <Name>AttackerObject</Name>
                      <Description>Defines which objects should spawn and attack the escorted ship(s).</Description>
                      <AllowedTemplates>QuestObjectList</AllowedTemplates>
                      <AllowedProperties/>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                  </Items>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Vector</DataType>
                  <Name>AttackerList</Name>
                  <Description>At list of attacker settings that are spawned during the escort quest</Description>
                  <Items>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Time</DataType>
                      <Name>SpawnTime</Name>
                      <Description>The time at which this attacker should spawn relativ to quest activation</Description>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Vector</DataType>
                      <Name>AttackerObjectList</Name>
                      <Description>List of attacker objects that should be spawned at this time interval</Description>
                      <Items>
                        <ValueDefinition>
                          <DataType>AutoCreateAsset</DataType>
                          <Name>AttackerObject</Name>
                          <AllowedTemplates>QuestObjectList</AllowedTemplates>
                          <AllowedProperties/>
                        </ValueDefinition>
                      </Items>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                  </Items>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                  <Name>HasEndlessAttacker</Name>
                  <Description>Indicates whether the escort will spawn attacker indefintely. This will be used after the last entry of the attacker list has been spawned</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Vector</DataType>
                  <Name>AttackerEndlessSpawn</Name>
                  <Description>The attacker objects that should be spawned as endless attacker</Description>
                  <Items>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>AutoCreateAsset</DataType>
                      <Name>AttackerObject</Name>
                      <AllowedTemplates>QuestObjectList</AllowedTemplates>
                      <AllowedProperties/>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                  </Items>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Time</DataType>
                  <Name>AttackerEndlessInterval</Name>
                  <Description>The time interval at which the endless attacker should be regularly spawned</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Float</DataType>
                  <Name>MinDistAttackerToObject</Name>
                  <Description>Defines the minimum distance from escorted ship where the attacker ships will spawn.</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Float</DataType>
                  <Name>MaxDistAttackerToObject</Name>
                  <Description>Defines the maximum distance from escorted ship where the attacker ships will spawn.</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Float</DataType>
                  <Name>DistMinBetweenAttacker</Name>
                  <Description>Minimum distance between multiple attackers when spawned</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Float</DataType>
                  <Name>DistMaxBetweenAttacker</Name>
                  <Description>Maximum distance between multiple attackers when spawned</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Time</DataType>
                  <Name>AttackerSpawnInterval</Name>
                  <Description>Defines the interval after which the first and all following attacker waves will spawn. Attacker waves spawn until the escorted ship is destroyed or leaves the map.</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                  <Name>NeedsShipInRange</Name>
                  <Description>Indicates whether there has to be a ship near the escort objects to be able to start the escort</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Text</DataType>
                  <Name>StarterHeadlineText</Name>
                  <NeededProperty>Text</NeededProperty>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Text</DataType>
                  <Name>StarterHeadlineTextWithoutShip</Name>
                  <Description>The objective text used when there does not have to a ship nearby</Description>
                  <NeededProperty>Text</NeededProperty>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Text</DataType>
                  <Name>TargetMapBorderText</Name>
                  <Description>The text that is used when the destination is the map border</Description>
                  <NeededProperty>Text</NeededProperty>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Vector</DataType>
                  <Name>EscortFinishObjects</Name>
                  <Items>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>AutoCreateAsset</DataType>
                      <Name>EscortFinishObject</Name>
                      <Description>Defines the objects that will spawn right at the place where the last escort ship reached it's destination.</Description>
                      <AllowedTemplates>QuestObjectList</AllowedTemplates>
                      <AllowedProperties/>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                  </Items>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                  <Name>StartImmediately</Name>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                  <Name>DespawnPrebuiltEscortObjects</Name>
                </ValueDefinition>
              </Property>

<Property>
            <Name>ObjectFilter</Name>

            </ValueDefinition>

              <DataType>Asset</DataType>
              <Name>ObjectGUID</Name>
              <Description>finds all objects with this GUID (performance critical!) which belong to ObjectParticipant</Description>
              <NeededProperty>Mesh</NeededProperty>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
              <Name>CheckParticipantID</Name>

              <DataType>Choice</DataType>
              <Name>ObjectParticipantID</Name>
              <Description>use together with ObjectGUID</Description>
              <DataSet>ParticipantID</DataSet>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
              <Name>ObjectUseParentConditionObjects</Name>
              <Description>Only used in Actions! Uses the objects that the parent condition found during evaluation. This is not implemented for many conditions yet, please contact PRG before you use this value</Description>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Vector</DataType>
              <Name>ObjectIslands</Name>
              <Items>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Asset</DataType>
                  <Name>Island</Name>
                  <NeededProperty>Island</NeededProperty>
                </ValueDefinition>
              </Items>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Asset</DataType>
              <Name>ObjectSession</Name>
              <Description>If provided, only objects from the given session are filtered</Description>
              <NeededProperty>Session</NeededProperty>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
              <Name>CheckQuestStarterSession</Name>
              <Description>If true and this action is fired from within a quest, the quest start session will be checked for objects</Description>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
              <Name>CheckQuestArea</Name>
              <Description>If true and this filter is used within a quest, then the current quest area (if any) will be used to filter objects</Description>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
              <Name>ObjectivePrebuiltObjectUseVisibilityAutomatism</Name>
              <Description>This flag is only used in quest objectives! If true the quest will remember the initial object visibility on quest start and set the object to visible. When the quest ends it will restore the initial visibility again. If false, the object visibility is not touched</Description>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
              <Name>ObjectRestrictToQuestObjects</Name>
              <Description>If true and this action is fired from within a quest, only objects that are used in the linked quest will be taken into account</Description>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
              <Name>IncludePreviewObjects</Name>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
              <Name>IncludeOnlyBlueprintObjects</Name>
              <Description>If true, ONLY blueprint objects will be filtered for. All other include booleans will be ignored in this case.</Description>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
              <Name>IncludeEditorObjects</Name>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Integer</DataType>
              <Name>MaxObjectCount</Name>
              <Description>If > 0 this will set an upper limit for the number of filtered objects. Objects will be chosen at random from the filtered object list</Description>
              <Min>0</Min>
            </ValueDefinition>
          </Property>

<Property>
        <Name>Reward</Name>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Vector</DataType>
          <Name>RewardAssets</Name>
          <Items>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Asset</DataType>
              <Name>Reward</Name>
              <NeededProperty>Product;Item;RewardPool;RegionRewardPool;ResourceRewardPool;Session;BuildPermit</NeededProperty>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Integer</DataType>
              <Name>Amount</Name>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
              <Name>SentToQuestArea</Name>
              <Description>Indicates if the reward should be sent to the kontor of the quest area</Description>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
              <Name>IsHidden</Name>
              <Description>Indicates whether this reward should not be shown as a reward preview upon quest invitation (i.e. Bonus Reward)</Description>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
              <Name>IsDisguised</Name>
              <Description>Indicates whether this (item) reward is disguised as visible, but unknown reward to not give away the actual item earned upon invitation</Description>
            </ValueDefinition>
          </Items>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Vector</DataType>
          <Name>RewardReputation</Name>
          <Description>List of reputation rewards distributed</Description>
          <Items>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Choice</DataType>
              <Name>ReputationParticipant</Name>
              <Description>The participant that rewards reputation</Description>
              <DataSet>ParticipantID</DataSet>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Integer</DataType>
              <Name>ReputationAmount</Name>
              <Description>The amount of reputation that is rewarded. This number can be negative to create a reputation loss</Description>
            </ValueDefinition>
          </Items>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
          <Name>GenerateIgnoreUnlocks</Name>
          <Description>do not check unlocks when generating rewards</Description>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
          <Name>GenerateRewardsUnique</Name>
          <Description>same Reward GUID is not chosen multiple times if a pool is listed as reward asset</Description>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Vector</DataType>
          <Name>PenaltyList</Name>
          <Items>

      <Items>
        <Item>
          <Name>Near</Name>
          <Description>Defines the min and max distance for spawn area calculated from the map borders (playable area). Values are percentages according to the current map's width (if the map's width != map's length, then the longest value is taken as reference)</Description>
          <Id>0</Id>
        </Item>
        <Item>
          <Name>Mid</Name>
          <Description>Defines the min and max distance for spawn area calculated from the map borders (playable area). Values are percentages according to the current map's width (if the map's width != map's length, then the longest value is taken as reference)</Description>
          <Id>1</Id>
        </Item>
        <Item>
          <Name>Far</Name>
          <Description>Defines the min and max distance for spawn area calculated from the map borders (playable area). Values are percentages according to the current map's width (if the map's width != map's length, then the longest value is taken as reference)</Description>
          <Id>2</Id>
        </Item>
      </Items>
    </DataSet>
